rationale: PINS THE CALLABLE-NAME SHAPES AND THE FOUR NAMES THAT MUST NOT BE PUBLISHED. Each row is a defect measured on the whole population on 2026-10-28, and each is pinned in both directions because every one of them published a name at some point. (1) A PARAMETRIC ALIAS DECLARES A TYPE NAME: `Dims{N} = NTuple{N,Int}` puts a `parametrized_type_expression` on the assignment's left, which is neither a call (a short-form method) nor a plain binding, so the assignment case skipped it — 43 sites corpus-wide (`Base.Dims`, `Base.AbstractVecOrTuple`, `Flux._ParallelONE`, `StaticArrays.SizedMatrix`) published no symbol and no `contains` row while the truth oracle derived all 43. (2) A CALL-OVERLOAD PATTERN IS NOT NAMED AFTER ITS ARGUMENT: `(m::Model)(x) = …` adds a method to Model's call table and declares no binding `m`; 423 such sites exist in the corpus and the analyzer's guard already refused the plain form. (3) THE `where` FORM LEAKED THROUGH `unwrapWhere`: `(t::Type{Model} where X)(x) = …` unwrapped the `where` and then walked THROUGH the `typed_expression` to the binding `t`, so the guard never saw a typed node and published `function t` plus a `contains` row (`julia/test/subtype.jl:2962` region, `julia/Compiler/test/irpasses.jl`). (4) A SPLICED MEMBER IS DYNAMIC: `(Base.$fJ)(x::Rational{BigInt}, …)` (`julia/base/gmp.jl`) named the overloaded function through a loop variable, and `fieldPath` read the RECEIVER — publishing `contains MPQ -> Base`, a module named as a member of another module. (5) AN INTERPOLATED TYPE HEAD IS A RUNTIME VALUE: `@eval struct $(Symbol(:T58129, k)){T} end` (`julia/test/subtype.jl:2962`) puts an interpolation at the base of a parameterized head and the identifier fallback read the TYPE PARAMETER `T` — publishing `decorates T -> eval`. (6) A LONG-FORM DECLARATION WITH NO ARGUMENT LIST (`@doc @doc(nothing) function bare_declaration end`, corpus shape Documenter.jl/doctestapi.jl) declares its name, and the macro applied to it decorates it — the truth side could not name a bare `signature (identifier)` and derived no row at all.
